snapshot.title: Who this is for
snapshot.description: Teams with a specific, repetitive workflow to speed up — not a general appetite for "adding AI" somewhere.

snapshot.title: What we build
snapshot.description: AI strategy, custom agents and RAG search grounded in your own data, and automation across the tools you already run.

snapshot.title: What matters most
snapshot.description: Accuracy, human oversight on anything consequential, and a measurable reduction in manual work.

useCases.title: Internal knowledge base search
useCases.description: Answers grounded in your own docs and SOPs, with sources — not a generic model's guess.

useCases.title: Support copilots
useCases.description: Draft responses and surface relevant history for support agents, human-reviewed before sending.

useCases.title: Document capture & review
useCases.description: Extract, classify, and route documents through an approval chain instead of manual entry.

useCases.title: Structured reporting
useCases.description: Turn recurring manual reports into an automated pipeline with a human check before it ships.

useCases.title: Cross-tool automation
useCases.description: Trigger actions across CRM, helpdesk, and internal tools without a person manually bridging them.

useCases.title: Anomaly & usage detection
useCases.description: Flag unusual patterns in operational or product usage data for a human to investigate.

useCases.title: AI strategy & feasibility
useCases.description: An honest map of where AI actually pays off in your workflow, before any building starts.

useCases.title: UX microcopy & content drafts
useCases.description: Faster first drafts for in-product copy and documentation, edited and approved by your team.

goodFit: A specific, repetitive workflow with a clear before/after
Internal documentation or SOPs that support/ops teams search constantly
Reporting or approval steps that are manual today but rule-based enough to automate
A team willing to keep a human in the loop on anything consequential
notIdeal: You want a general-purpose chatbot with no specific workflow attached
The task requires judgment calls with no acceptable error rate and no human review step
Source data is too inconsistent or sparse to ground answers in yet

process.title: Use-case mapping
process.description: We map where AI could realistically save time or reduce error in your actual workflow — not a generic capability list.

process.title: Feasibility & data check
process.description: We check whether the data needed to ground the system reliably actually exists and is accessible.

process.title: Design & guardrails
process.description: Scope what the system can and can't do on its own, and where a human reviews before anything ships.

process.title: Build & evaluate
process.description: Iterative build with real test cases, evaluated against accuracy and failure-mode criteria, not just a demo.

process.title: Launch & monitor
process.description: Release with monitoring in place, so drift or failure modes get caught early, not after they compound.

guardrails: Human review on anything consequential — no fully autonomous high-stakes actions by default
Grounded in your own data via RAG, not relying on a model's unverified general knowledge
Evaluation against real test cases before launch, not just a working demo
Clear logging of what the system did and why, for anything that touches real operations
Data handling scoped to what the use case actually needs — no unnecessary data exposure

faqs.a: No — every automation we build keeps a human in the loop on consequential decisions. The goal is removing manual busywork, not decision-making.

faqs.q: How do you handle hallucination or wrong answers?
faqs.a: By grounding answers in your own data via RAG rather than relying on a model's general knowledge, and evaluating against real test cases before launch.
We scope data access to exactly what the use case needs, and can work within your existing security and access-control requirements.

faqs.q: Do we need our documentation cleaned up first?
faqs.a: Not perfectly — but a feasibility check happens early specifically to catch data gaps before we build on top of them.

faqs.q: Can you integrate with our existing tools?
faqs.a: Yes — most AI and automation engagements are as much about integration (CRM, helpdesk, internal tools) as they are about the model itself.

faqs.q: How do we measure if it's working?
faqs.a: We define success criteria — time saved, error rate, resolution speed — before launch, so impact is measurable, not anecdotal.
